titleEn: Kubota Expands Autonomous Solutions and Introduces the M5L Tractor for Specialty Crops
titleZh: 久保田扩展自主解决方案，推出面向特种作物的M5L拖拉机
summaryZh: 久保田北美公司宣布与Agtonomy合作进入新阶段，将自主作业能力集成到M5低矮型柴油拖拉机上，面向果园和坚果种植者，支持喷洒、割草和树下耕作等核心特种作物作业。该举措基于种植者反馈，旨在帮助种植者将自主解决方案融入现有柴油拖拉机作业流程，提升效率、适应性和生产力。
featuredReason: 该新闻展示了农机巨头久保田在果园和坚果等特种作物领域的自主化落地进展，其“低矮机型+自主软件+经销商支持”的模式对智慧畜牧中设施农业、果园养殖等场景的自动化集成具有参考价值，尤其适合关注农业机器人商业化路径的从业者。
contentFull:
By Kubota 

 

 Share

 

 

 

 

 

 Kubota North America has announced the next phase of its strategic collaboration with Agtonomy, an award-winning agricultural autonomy software company, to expand the pilot phase to include autonomous operations on the Kubota M5 Low Profile diesel tractor for orchard and nut growers. The initiative builds on the companies’ work to commercialize practical autonomy on Kubota equipment and reflects Kubota’s ongoing commitment to developing smart technology that enhances efficiency, adaptability and productivity for specialty crop customers.

 “Kubota values our relationship with Agtonomy and is committed to finding solutions for the specialty agricultural market and associated growers,” said Don Lowe, Senior Director for Kubota Tractor Corporation. “Expanding our autonomous platform with Agtonomy confirms another vital step towards the commercialization of our high-quality products into this important segment.”

 This next phase will focus on integrating Agtonomy’s capabilities with Kubota’s M5 Low Profile tractor to support core specialty-crop workloads, including spraying, mowing and underplant cultivation. The low-profile design and added lift capacity of the M5L will allow the companies to address a broader set of orchard applications, including sanitation mowing, while helping growers introduce autonomous solutions into their existing diesel tractor operations.

 The pilot phase expansion is informed by successful engagement with growers and continued feedback from specialty crop operations. While the M5N is tailored to narrow-row applications, the M5L brings a low-profile platform and increased lift capacity suited to the distinct needs of orchard and nut operations. Kubota dealer support will remain an important part of helping growers integrate the technology into their existing workflow.

 “As a specialty crop grower myself, I know how much orchard work depends on having the right equipment and skilled people available when the job needs to get done,” said Tim Bucher, CEO and Co-Founder of Agtonomy. “Bringing our technology to the M5L is a direct response to that need and an important next step in helping growers get essential work done with the skilled labor they have available.”

translationZh:
久保田北美公司宣布与屡获殊荣的农业自主软件公司Agtonomy战略合作的下一阶段，将试点阶段扩展至包括久保田M5低矮型柴油拖拉机上的自主作业，面向果园和坚果种植者。该计划建立在两家公司合作将实用自主技术商业化应用于久保田设备的基础上，反映了久保田持续致力于开发智能技术，以提升特种作物客户的效率、适应性和生产力。

久保田拖拉机公司高级总监Don Lowe表示：“久保田重视与Agtonomy的关系，并致力于为特种农业市场及相关种植者寻找解决方案。与Agtonomy扩展我们的自主平台，确认了我们将高质量产品商业化推向这一重要细分市场的又一关键步骤。”

下一阶段将专注于将Agtonomy的能力与久保田M5低矮型拖拉机集成，以支持核心特种作物工作负载，包括喷洒、割草和树下耕作。M5L的低矮设计和增加的提升能力将使两家公司能够应对更广泛的果园应用，包括卫生割草，同时帮助种植者将自主解决方案引入其现有的柴油拖拉机作业中。

试点阶段的扩展得益于与种植者的成功互动以及特种作物作业的持续反馈。M5N专为窄行应用量身定制，而M5L则提供低矮平台和增加的提升能力，适合果园和坚果作业的独特需求。久保田经销商支持仍将是帮助种植者将该技术整合到现有工作流程中的重要组成部分。

“作为一名特种作物种植者，我深知果园作业在多大程度上依赖于在需要完成工作时拥有合适的设备和熟练人员，”Agtonomy首席执行官兼联合创始人Tim Bucher表示。“将我们的技术引入M5L是对这一需求的直接回应，也是帮助种植者利用现有熟练劳动力完成基本工作的重要下一步。”
